content.title: Multi-Vehicle Robot Assembly | Component Mapping, Load Order, Hero Proof
content.summary: Crawler, drone and medical pod assemble into one function-readable rescue robot. Preserve the five causal invariants, stable spatial anchors and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: Every source module is established before assembly. + Each module maps to one body function only. + Load-bearing parts lock before upper components. + Assembly paths remain visible and non-overlapping. + The complete robot accounts for and proves every module.
quick_start.recommended_input: Introduce three original rescue modules: a compact crawler, a twin-rotor drone and a white medical pod. Fold the drone rotors into shoulder braces while its central body becomes the upper torso. Reveal one complete original rescue robot; briefly highlight crawler, drone and pod functions, then hold the hero silhouette.
required_anchors: Every source module is established before assembly.
Each module maps to one body function only.
Assembly paths remain visible and non-overlapping.
The complete robot accounts for and proves every module.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Crawler, drone and medical pod assemble into one function-readable rescue robot. Preserve the five causal invariants, stable spatial anchors and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
